anatomy.demo: MaterialPeopleRhythmOrigin

parts.desc: 颜色、质地和形状来自真实产品与环境
parts.desc_en: Color, texture, and shape drawn from the real product and environment

parts.desc: 手、过程和使用场景比抽象环保符号更有说服力
parts.desc_en: Hands, process, and use context instead of generic sustainability symbols

parts.desc: 留白与排版放慢阅读，同时保持清楚的行动路径
parts.desc_en: Whitespace and typography that slow reading without hiding the next step

parts.desc: 用产地、材料和做法说明价值来自哪里
parts.desc_en: Place, material, and method translated into concrete value

use.t: 食品、健康、香氛和家居品牌：材料与生活场景是价值的一部分
小批量手作与可持续产品：来源和过程可以成为内容主线
民宿、餐厅和慢旅行：真实空间与人物能自然建立期待
个人服务和工作室：需要表达专业之外的亲近与照顾

dont.t: 只使用米色而缺少材料与内容关系：难以形成清楚的品牌表达
用“天然、纯净”代替事实：应写清材料、来源和实际做法
纹理覆盖正文：纸张和颗粒感应待在阅读层后面
视觉过于安静而弱化行动：购买、预约和联系入口仍需清楚可见

principles.t: 从真实材料和场景取色：颜色应与产品、土地、空间或人物建立关系
摄影比纹理更重要：真实过程、手和环境能建立可感知的温度
柔和节奏仍要有层级：衬线标题、正文和行动不能一起变得轻飘
来源与承诺写具体：产地、材料、数量和做法比“天然”两个字更可信

entry.prompt: 为小批量香氛品牌做官网。用可核验的原料、产地和制作过程讲清产品来源，搭配自然但不过度装饰的画面；购买或预约入口要明显，文字始终易读。只使用我提供的资料，缺少的产地、材料或工艺信息先标为“待补充”，并列出需要确认的内容，不要自行补造。
entry.prompt_en: Organic design brand website, earth tones and forest green, flowing natural curves and irregular shapes, authentic nature and craft-process photography, serif display type with readable sans-serif body, subtle paper grain, specific origin and material information, clear purchase or booking action

en.prompt: Organic design brand website, earth tones and forest green, flowing natural curves and irregular shapes, authentic nature and craft-process photography, serif display type with readable sans-serif body, subtle paper grain, specific origin and material information, clear purchase or booking action

use.t: Food, wellness, fragrance, and home brands where material and use context are part of the value
Small-batch craft and sustainable products whose origin and process can lead the story
Hospitality, restaurants, and slow travel where real space and people create expectation
Personal services and studios that need warmth and care alongside expertise

dont.t: Turn every surface beige; without material, content, and typographic relationships, the result is only flat
Use natural and pure instead of facts; explain material, source, and actual practice
Place texture over body text; paper and grain belong behind the reading layer
Make the action disappear in the quiet mood; purchase, booking, and contact still need clear affordance

principles.t: Take color from real material and place: connect the palette to the product, land, room, or people
Prioritize photography over texture: real processes, hands, and environments create believable warmth
Keep hierarchy inside the gentle pace: serif headlines, body text, and actions cannot all fade into softness
Make origin and promises specific: place, material, quantity, and method are more credible than natural alone
